thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: rate-limiter rollout v2 triggered a spike in 503s for some dedicated customers. automatic canary flag flipped to ON at 1768501210. observed surge in blocked requests and missing exemption entries.
Priya K: seeing the same on dashboards — token-usage spikes and a lot of 403/429 -> 503 cascades. customers complaining about stalled inference jobs.
Sam H: quick check — canary was rolled to 15% traffic last deploy, config `rl_v2_exemptions_enabled=true` supposed to map old exemptions to new table. looks like mapping job failed.
Olivia R: @Priya can you confirm which customers impacted? CS Pager pinged about 3 accounts with enterprise traffic.
Priya K: from logs: cust-a, cust-b (EU), and internal test accounts. Estimated ~0.8% of total calls but concentrated on long-running sessions -> high user-visible failures.
Maya L: adding context — the migration script `migrate_exemptions.py` threw duplicate-key errors; I see retries were suppressed by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: deploy: v2-ratecap config applied by @Maya L 1768501198 — automatic migration job started. error: `KeyError: 'exclusion_id'` at attempt 2. see /deploy/logs/1768501198.
SRE Shift: recommend flipping the canary kill-switch to prevent further traffic to v2. command: `rbacctl feature-toggle rl_v2_use :off --scope=canary`
Priya K: agreed, doing kill-switch now.
Priya K: (executed) `Feature rl_v2_use (canary) => OFF` — routing reverted to v1.
incident-bot: notice: Canary traffic rollback initiated at 1768501430. routing back to stable v1.
Sam H: after rollback, error rate dropped ~92% in 5m window. metrics: 503->baseline. still seeing some ack backlog from the migration attempts.
Olivia R: CS Pager: we've acknowledged, mitigation in progress — rollback performed, customers should see recovery. We'll follow up with postmortem.
CS Pager: Thanks team — alerted customers to expect recovery; asking for ETA on full remediation and whether token accounting needs backfill.
Maya L: migration job left some rows half-mapped. I propose re-running migration with strict idempotency and dry-run on a subset of customer IDs. patch ready: add `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` and extra logging.
Sam H: agree. Also need to reconcile token ledger — some requests that were supposed to be exempt got counted; billing may be affected. We should disable auto-billing export for the window.
Priya K: created internal ticket: INC-176850 — scope: reconcile exemptions + billing hold. assigning to billing and migration owners.
SRE Shift: handing off to night oncall @Sam H — please monitor for delayed failures and customer escalations.
Sam H: taking over oncall. I will keep a watch on 1h, will escalate if errors > 0.5% sustained.
Olivia R: steps checklist I ran: 1) flip canary off 2) verify routing 3) notify CS 4) create reconciliation ticket 5) schedule migration rerun as canary-free job.
Maya L: plan for safe rerun: run dry-run against cust-a and internal test, verify `exemptions_count` parity, then schedule full run during low-traffic window (02:00 UTC).
CS Pager: customers want confirmation that tokens during the incident window won't be billed incorrectly. Sam, can you confirm billing hold?
Sam H: placed billing export hold and notified Finance. Will coordinate with billing team tomorrow morning. ticket FIN-176851.
incident-bot: incident severity set to SEV2 at 1768501450. paging suppressed for now; oncall owning.
Priya K: quick log snippet for postmortem: 
```
ERROR migrate_exemptions: duplicate key on insert -> exception suppressed
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/migrate/migrate_exemptions.py", line 212, in run
    insert_exemption(row)
  File "/srv/migrate/db.py", line 88, in insert_exemption
    cur.execute("INSERT INTO exemptions ...")
psycopg2.errors.UniqueViolation: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "exemptions_pkey"
```
Sam H: timeline so far: 1768501198 deploy->migration started; 1768501210 canary -> ON; 17685013xx error spike; 1768501430 kill-switch -> OFF; 1768501500 errors back to baseline.
Olivia R: scheduling 1hr post-incident sync at 1768508400 in #incidents for full RCA and customer comms draft.
Maya L: I'll prepare migration patch and test plan.
CS Pager: will draft customer notification acknowledging outage window and that billing is on hold pending reconciliation.
Sam H: leaving a note for follow-up: - validate no remaining half-applied exemptions - ensure migration is idempotent - add canary health gate to block automated migrations on key errors
Priya K: thanks all — marking this thread as active incident. I'll update INC-176850 as we progress.
SRE Shift: handing off final: oncall -> Sam H. monitoring set to 30m cadence.
Sam H: confirm monitoring stable at 30m checks. if anything flares, re-open paging. :thumbsup:
